load_gt_calibration: load ground truth camera calibration JSON from simulation and return rig-to-view transforms and intrinsics
load_trajectory: load device trajectory from CSV files and return timestamped world-to-rig PoseTW transforms
load_obbs_gt: load 2D and 3D bounding box ground truth observations including instance-to-prototype mappings from an input directory
read_image_snippet_from_vrs: read a snippet of images from a VRS file within a time range and return stacked tensors with camera poses
load_global_points_csv: load and filter global 3D points from a CSV file by inverse depth std and observation count with caching
